This operation requires you to specify the workspace name, repository slug, and the unique identifier of the branch restriction rule you want to delete. By deleting a branch restriction rule, you effectively remove those constraints from the specified branches in your repository. This operation is useful when you need to modify your repository's branch protection strategy, remove outdated restrictions, or adjust team workflows. Authentication and appropriate permissions are required to execute this operation successfully, as it affects repository security and collaboration policies.
